system.description:
Your accuracy improves when you act on instinct. Though you might call it luck, The Force is with you.

Prerequisite: Cannot be a Droid

Effect: When you use a Force Point when making an attack with a weapon with which you are proficient, you can reroll the attack and take the better result. Apply the results of the die from the Force Point to the better result.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
